recent_reviews.title: I’ve been a Lifeforce member for…
recent_reviews.body: I’ve been a Lifeforce member for several years, and my recent experiences have been extremely disappointing. Most recently, I was prescribed 30 tablets but received only 17 in my shipment. This is a serious medication error, not a minor issue. When I contacted customer service, I was told this was “not a big deal,” which is unacceptable given that this involves my health. What’s even more concerning is that this is not an isolated incident. In the past, my prescription was delayed/held back by a customer service representative for no clear reason, causing unnecessary stress and disruption. At the same time, I am paying $129/month for membership and $80 for prescription. Being charged in full while dealing with repeated issues, lack of accountability, and poor customer service is simply not acceptable. For a company operating in the healthcare space, accuracy, reliability, and responsiveness should be basic standards. Unfortunately, my experience has been the opposite. I hope Lifeforce takes this seriously and makes significant improvements.

recent_reviews.body: They did an in depth blood work panel and ended up recommending 3 prescriptions and multiple supplements that had me taking over 20 pills a day and spending around $500/month not including the $149 monthly fee for the service. Between appointments I could not get in touch with my NP at all, emailing took 1 to 2 days for a response and it took FOREVER to find a phone number to call support. After explaining I was not experiencing any symptom relief, I was told well that's all they can do on their end and referred me back to my PCP. Refused to retest by blood work earlier that just a week before they felt it should be done (which was 3+months) as well as realizing that I was put on meds for this that were in normal ranges and also were not meant to be taken long term. I followed up with my own research into scientific research, peer reviewed articles and journals as well as several meta studies, concluding it seems they are just like everyone else they are pushing pills for profit. No thank you. One more note when I asked for documentation to provide my job due to the HEALTH ISSUES AND AUTO IMMUNE DISORDER they are giving me PRESCRIPTIONS for, I was told no sorry, we don't give documentation because we're providing proactive services. What a waste of my money time and health.

recent_reviews.title: I’ve been working with Lifeforce for…
recent_reviews.body: I’ve been working with Lifeforce for about four months now. I signed up for the subscription, which included a blood draw and a consultation with a PA to review the results. The initial experience was excellent. The blood draw was done at my home, right on time, and the whole process was smooth and easy. About a week later, I had my consultation with the PA, who walked me through my elevated markers and recommended a supplement protocol. My main goals were improving sleep (I deal with interrupted sleep), balancing hormones, and supporting muscle recovery. I followed the protocol exactly as prescribed, which included about five supplements over roughly 3–4 months. After staying fully compliant, I did a follow-up blood test—and unfortunately, my markers were even more elevated than before. That was frustrating and disappointing, especially since I was consistent with everything. To their credit, the team suggested making adjustments and fine-tuning the protocol, which I appreciate. But at the same time, it’s hard to ignore that the results didn’t move in the right direction after several months of commitment. Overall, the service, communication, and convenience were all excellent. The blood draw and consultation process were top-notch. But for me, the outcome is what matters most—and based on my experience so far, I’m not seeing the results I was hoping for. I share this simply so others know that, while the process is professional and well run, the results aren’t guaranteed and may take more trial and error than expected. For now, I’ll likely be canceling my subscription.

recent_reviews.title: Lifeforce sells pills you don’t need
recent_reviews.body: Lifeforce recommended I take 3 different hormone supplements, as well as testosterone therapy based off their lab results which I had performed at same time as my primary dr. Lifeforce’s lab showed much more dramatic results than my primary which should have been my first warning sign. I refused to take most of the supplements and meds the Lifeforce clinician said I needed over a zoom call, but did agree to try DHEA supplementation for 3 months. Now, 3 months later none of my lab results are much different but my life is in shambles after becoming an angry and aggressive jerk on the supplement and not identifying it as the cause in time to protect my loved ones from my severe mood swings, anger and depression that developed. These mood changes, it turns out, are quite common with these supplements and hormone therapies but were never spoken of in my consultation with the clinician aka supplement sales rep. This company is selling pseudo science with real world dangers for individual health outcomes and should be stopped. Go see a real Dr and skip this scam of an operation. I am a healthy 47 male with no history of mood disorders fyi. This company doesn’t care about health outcomes—they care about selling supplements and taking your $$.
